channel.title: InvestPR Media Monitoring
channel.description: Real capital continued moving into Puerto Rico: Ferrovial's $207-239M autonomous-construction airport runway in Aguadilla, four new solar-plus-storage farms in Salinas set to double utility-scale renewable capacity, and steady reinvestment from MassMutual ($1.5M), Enterprise ($650K), RioBlanco ($45M) and Marriott ($38M). Federal support remained a tailwind, with FEMA's $108.9M grid-modernization award and NIST's $30M manufacturing-extension funding, though the WRDA water-infrastructure bill still needs Senate reconciliation. Risks are building on the fiscal and energy side: the Planning Board cut its GNP growth forecast again, LUMA warned bills could rise $48/month after 18 recent load-shedding events, and multiple reports flagged a looming ~90% cut to federal Medicaid funding by 2027 that could hit up to 1.3 million residents.
